comments.body:
Phase 1 RCA (pre-fix):

Step 0(a): duplicate sweep found this bug (`pathworky-unrivaled-firefly`) plus the ops ledger that discovered it; prior closed c943 is a related LLM-Review voter precedent, not a duplicate of the CI Verified workflow.
Step 0(b): no version field; report created_at 1788369753410902832 maps to `origin/main` floor 952f0825321c755f41edce412ad1fe9f1db9268d. The suspect workflow line range has not changed since that floor.
Step 0(c): fresh worktree `/Users/joeoakhart/debug-adab-closed-vote` is at 952f0825321c755f41edce412ad1fe9f1db9268d (= `origin/main`).

Observed mechanism: `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` final `vote` job step `Cast Verified from the CI conclusion` delegates directly to `lfreleng-actions/gerrit-review-action` (lines 504-523 on the working tree). The representative run log for 33580445347 shows the workflow conclusion normalized to `vote-type='success'`, then the action shell ran `ssh ... gerrit review 2483,7 ...`, Gerrit returned `error: fatal: change is closed` / `fatal: one or more reviews failed`, and GitHub failed the step with exit code 1. That proves the runtime path treats every nonzero `gerrit review` as a red CI failure, including the closed-change race.

Authoritative intent / design-decision check: ADR 0020/0023 require CI to cast `Verified` independently and fail closed when the SSH vote cannot be cast on an open/voteable change. They do not require a red run after the target change has already become unvoteable. Closed precedent c943 records that Gerrit `409` / `change is closed` for a merged/abandoned change is terminal/non-actionable for the LLM-Review voter. No ADR found that forbids treating a closed/abandoned/merged vote-time race as a benign no-op.

Confirmed root cause: the final CI Verified cast is implemented as an opaque third-party action invocation with no wrapper around the `gerrit review` exit status, so the workflow has no branch that can classify Gerrit's specific `fatal: change is closed` response as terminal/no-op while preserving failures for open changes.

Defect legitimacy: defect. It violates the ticket AC and the two-vote gate's intent: CI result should vote when the change is voteable; a change that has already been abandoned/merged cannot receive a vote and should not make an otherwise successful gate run red.

Attribution: scope-of-work omission in the original two-vote Verified gate implementation, commit 49ad69bcd242cfa7969331fc813805432072d791 (`feat: CI as a second Gerrit gate vote (Verified) via gerrit-to-platform`, epic/story family 1fa8). Blame/log -L on the final cast step shows the direct action invocation was introduced there; later commits only normalized inputs or comments/pins and did not add/remove a closed-change handler. I will recover the exact origin ticket id for `--caused-by` before close.

Fix plan: add a small trusted helper `scripts/cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`, sparse-check it out in the vote job, and replace only the final cast action with a shell step that installs the same SSH material, runs `gerrit review`, exits 0 with a clear notice only when Gerrit's output contains `fatal: change is closed`, and returns the original nonzero code for every other vote failure. Keep the clear-vote start step unchanged. Add script tests for closed-change RED/GREEN, other failures, success command shape, and validation; update existing workflow structural tests to pin the final cast helper boundary.

## Observed signal
Error sweep window 2026-09-01T11:58:00-07:00..2026-09-02T10:00:00-07:00 (2026-09-01T18:58:00Z..2026-09-02T17:00:00Z) found a Gerrit Verified Gate run that reached the final vote-cast step and then failed the GitHub Actions run because Gerrit rejected the review as targeting a closed change.

Representative run: 33580445347 (Gerrit Verified Gate, workflow_dispatch, created 2026-09-02T01:42:29Z, head 024a6a2278134128be0c76c8d7c60e41b4ba817d). The `cast Verified` job had `WORKFLOW_CONCLUSION=success`, `VOTE_TYPE=success`, `GERRIT_CHANGE_NUMBER=2483`, `GERRIT_PATCHSET_NUMBER=7`, then failed with:

`error: fatal: change is closed`
`fatal: one or more reviews failed; review output above`

## Root cause
The final Gerrit voting step treats Gerrit's `change is closed` response as a hard Actions failure even when the underlying gate work has already concluded and the patchset/change is no longer voteable. This creates red CI noise after a submit/close race rather than recording a benign superseded/closed disposition.

## Plan
Replace only the final `Cast Verified from the CI conclusion` step's opaque `gerrit-review-action` invocation with a trusted repo helper at `scripts/cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`, checked out from the default branch by adding that path to the vote job's existing sparse-checkout list.

The helper will install the same SSH key/known_hosts material and invoke Gerrit's SSH review command for the `Verified` label, preserving the observed action-expanded command and run-URL message shape from run 33580445347 (`<STATUS>: <run URL>`). The run log for 33580445347 shows the action maps `success` to `LABELS="--label Verified=1"`, `failure` to `LABELS="--label Verified=-1"`, and `cancelled` to `LABELS="--label Verified=-1 --label Code-Review=-1"`, then reaches `ssh ... gerrit review 2483,7 ...`. ADR 0023 defines the inbound path as SSH `gerrit review` setting `Verified +1` for success or `Verified -1` for failed/cancelled.

Result classification and safety guards:

- Map normalized vote-type domain to the same label tokens the action log shows: `success -> --label Verified=1`; `failure -> --label Verified=-1`; `cancelled -> --label Verified=-1 --label Code-Review=-1`.
- Validate `CHANGE_NUMBER` and `PATCHSET_NUMBER` as positive decimal integers before invoking SSH, matching the existing cast/comment boundary.
- Write the private key and a dedicated known-hosts file under `$HOME/.ssh`, chmod both `600`, invoke `ssh -i <key> -p 29418 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=<dedicated-known-hosts> -- <user>@<server> ...`, and remove both files in a `finally` path after the vote attempt.
- If Gerrit output contains `fatal: change is closed`, print an Actions notice naming the change/patchset and exit 0 because the change has already moved to a terminal unvoteable state.
- For every other nonzero SSH/Gerrit result, return the original nonzero exit code so real inability to vote an open change still fails closed.
- Keep the start-of-run clear vote action unchanged; this bug is only about the final cast race after CI has completed.
- Mark the final workflow step with `predates-gate-ok` because the helper is deliberately fetched from the trusted default branch, not the patchset tree, and lock the new CI gate step in `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` so full pytest and the mechanism-delta gate agree on the committed mechanism set.

Test impact: rewrite the existing `tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` assertions that currently pin `gerrit-review-action` as the final cast step. In particular, replace `test_only_one_step_casts_a_vote` with a helper-focused assertion that the vote job has exactly one `Cast Verified from the CI conclusion` step, that this step runs `python3 scripts/cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`, and that this final cast step no longer uses `gerrit-review-action`. Also update the normalized-vote and ordering assertions to locate the step by its name, and update the default-branch sparse-checkout assertion to include `scripts/cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py`. The new helper tests will use `tests._subprocess_env.subprocess_env` so they do not reintroduce unsafe raw environment reprs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Closed-change race: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_closed_change_is_a_successful_noop` proves a Gerrit `fatal: change is closed` response exits 0 and emits a clear notice instead of reddening the run.
- [ ] Real vote failures remain fail-closed: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_other_vote_failures_still_fail` proves an unrelated SSH/Gerrit failure preserves its nonzero exit code and stderr.
- [ ] Success vote shape is preserved: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_success_vote_uses_the_verified_label_and_run_url` proves the helper sends `gerrit review <change>,<patchset>`, `--label Verified=1`, port 29418, and the run URL message.
- [ ] Failure/cancelled vote shape is preserved: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_failure_vote_uses_verified_minus_one tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_cancelled_vote_uses_verified_minus_one` proves `failure` sends `--label Verified=-1` and `cancelled` sends `--label Verified=-1 --label Code-Review=-1` with the matching status message.
- [ ] SSH safety guards are preserved: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_invalid_change_and_patchset_numbers_fail_before_ssh tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_ssh_secret_files_are_chmod_600_and_removed_after_vote` proves bad change/patchset identifiers never reach SSH and the private key/known-hosts material is chmodded and removed after use.
- [ ] Workflow trust boundary is pinned: `pytest -q tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py` proves the vote job uses the default-branch helper, consumes the normalized vote type, posts triage detail only after the vote, and keeps the observability steps non-failing/comment-only.
- [ ] Workflow guard/baseline integration remains green: `pytest -q tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py::test_all_non_fixture_subprocess_environments_use_the_safe_boundary tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree`.
- [ ] Existing conclusion normalization and triage summarization still pass: `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py tests/scripts/test_summarize_ci_failures.py`.
- [ ] Repository gates pass for the changed paths: `make lint` and `make typecheck`.

## Testing
Run the targeted workflow/script suite:

`pytest -q tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py tests/scripts/test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py tests/scripts/test_summarize_ci_failures.py tests/unit/test_gerrit_verify_triage_comment.py tests/unit/test_predates_gate_guard_parity.py::test_completeness_every_gate_step_is_guarded_or_marked tests/unit/test_subprocess_env_repr_security.py::test_all_non_fixture_subprocess_environments_use_the_safe_boundary tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_check_passes_on_the_committed_tree tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree`

Run full code-quality gates:

`make lint`
`make typecheck`

Mutation check: temporarily reintroduce the defect by returning the Gerrit nonzero return code on `fatal: change is closed`, then run `pytest -q tests/scripts/test_cast_gerrit_verified_vote.py::test_closed_change_is_a_successful_noop` inside `sandbox-exec`; it must fail RED, then restore the fix.
